## 5. Frozen per-n1 classification

Only when every cell of that n1 passes E0-E3: 'analytic faster' if every median ratio N/A >= 1.1, 'analytic slower' if every ratio <= 1/1.1, otherwise 'no consistent difference'. Pilot evidence on these cells only.

- n1 = 2: 5 cells, gates pass = True, median ratio N/A range 0.658-1.023 -> **no consistent difference**
- n1 = 3: 4 cells, gates pass = True, median ratio N/A range 0.741-1.060 -> **no consistent difference**
